title: Midjourney AI Pricing Your Guide to Plans and Costs

facts.fact: Midjourney's Basic plan costs $10 per month.
facts.quote: monthly plans kicking off at **$10 for the Basic plan** and scaling up to **$120 for the Mega plan**.

facts.fact: Midjourney's Mega plan costs $120 per month.
facts.quote: scaling up to **$120 for the Mega plan**.

facts.fact: Midjourney offers a 20% discount when subscribers pay annually.
facts.quote: there's a **20% discount** if you pay annually.

facts.fact: Every Midjourney tier except the entry-level Basic plan includes unlimited Relax Mode generations.
facts.quote: Every tier, except for the entry-level one, also gets you unlimited "Relax Mode" generations

facts.fact: Midjourney's Basic plan costs $8 per month when paid annually.
facts.quote: | **Basic** | $10 | $8 / mo | 3.3 hrs (~200 images) | No |

facts.fact: Midjourney's Standard plan costs $30 per month, or $24 per month when paid annually.
facts.quote: | **Standard** | $30 | $24 / mo | 15 hrs (~900 images) | Unlimited |

facts.fact: Midjourney's Pro plan costs $60 per month, or $48 per month when paid annually.
facts.quote: | **Pro** | $60 | $48 / mo | 30 hrs (~1,800 images) | Unlimited |

facts.fact: Midjourney's Mega plan costs $96 per month when paid annually.
facts.quote: | **Mega** | $120 | $96 / mo | 60 hrs (~3,600 images) | Unlimited |

facts.fact: The Mega plan includes 60 hours of Fast GPU time per month, roughly 3,600 images.
facts.quote: It serves up a massive **60 hours of Fast GPU time**, good for about **3,600 images**.

facts.fact: The Pro and Mega plans each allow up to 12 concurrent Fast jobs.
facts.quote: The Pro plan also lets you run up to **12 concurrent Fast jobs**.

facts.fact: The Pro plan is the first tier that unlocks Stealth Mode, which keeps all generated images private.
facts.quote: this is the first tier that unlocks **Stealth Mode**. By default, every image you make on the Basic and Standard plans is public.

facts.fact: Images made on the Basic and Standard plans are public by default.
facts.quote: By default, every image you make on the Basic and Standard plans is public.

facts.fact: Midjourney reportedly has a community of over 21 million registered users.
facts.quote: This surge is backed by a community of over 21 million registered users.

facts.fact: The Standard plan includes 15 hours of Fast GPU time per month.
facts.quote: if you're on the Standard plan with its **15 hours of Fast GPU time**

facts.fact: The page's rule of thumb is that one image generation job uses about 1 minute of Fast GPU time.
facts.quote: **1 image generation job** generally eats up about **1 minute of Fast GPU time**.

facts.fact: On the Standard plan, the page estimates roughly 900 Fast image generations per month from its 15 Fast GPU hours.
facts.quote: you can bank on roughly **900 Fast image generations** a month

facts.fact: Each Midjourney job returns a grid of four initial image options.
facts.quote: Since each job gives you a grid of four initial options

facts.fact: Paid subscribers can buy extra Fast GPU hours at $4 per hour.
facts.quote: All paid subscribers can buy extra Fast GPU hours for **$4 per hour**.

facts.fact: The Standard plan is priced at $30.
facts.quote: Take the **$30 Standard plan**, which comes with **15 hours** of Fast GPU time.

facts.fact: The page calculates an effective Fast Mode cost of about $0.033 per image on the Standard plan ($30 divided by 900 images).
facts.quote: each image on the Standard plan sets you back about **$0.033** ($30 ÷ 900 images)

facts.fact: The Basic plan provides 3.3 Fast GPU hours per month, an estimated ~200 Fast images, and an estimated ~$0.050 cost per image.
The Pro plan provides 30 Fast GPU hours per month, an estimated ~1,800 Fast images, and an estimated ~$0.033 cost per image.
The Mega plan provides 60 Fast GPU hours per month, an estimated ~3,600 Fast images, and an estimated ~$0.033 cost per image.
Standard, Pro, and Mega subscribers can switch to Relax Mode once Fast GPU hours run out.
facts.quote: anyone on the Standard, Pro, or Mega plans can switch over to **Relax Mode**.

facts.fact: Relax Mode is described as unlimited and does not consume paid Fast GPU hours.
facts.quote: It's totally unlimited and doesn’t burn through your precious paid GPU hours.

facts.fact: In Relax Mode, wait times range from a few seconds to several minutes depending on server load.
facts.value: a few seconds to several minutes
facts.quote: the wait time can be anything from a few seconds to several minutes, all depending on how busy the servers are.

facts.fact: The page states that Fast Mode generations appear in under a minute.
facts.quote: your generations pop up in under a minute

facts.fact: Users can check their remaining Fast GPU hours by typing the /info command in Discord.
facts.quote: Just type the `/info` command into Discord.

facts.fact: On the Standard plan, using Relax Mode for an equal number of additional images lowers the effective cost per image to about $0.016, per the page's example.
facts.quote: their effective cost per image gets slashed in half to just **$0.016**.

facts.fact: Companies with more than $1 million in annual gross revenue must be on the Pro or Mega plan to use generated images commercially, according to the page's description of Midjourney's terms.
facts.quote: If your company brings in more than **$1 million in annual gross revenue**, you are required to be on the **Pro or Mega plan**

facts.fact: Any paid Midjourney plan grants the subscriber general ownership of created assets for commercial use.
facts.quote: Once you're on any paid Midjourney plan—whether it's Basic, Standard, Pro, or Mega—you generally own the assets you create.

facts.fact: The page states that the free trial allows image generation but not commercial use.
facts.quote: the old free trial was just for looking. You could generate images, but you couldn't legally use them for anything that makes money.

facts.fact: The Pro plan includes Stealth Mode, which the page describes as a feature valuable to agencies.
facts.quote: the **Pro plan** has a feature that's worth its weight in gold: **Stealth Mode**.

facts.fact: Images generated on the Basic and Standard Midjourney plans are public by default, appearing in the main community feed with the prompt visible.
facts.quote: By default, every single image you generate on the Basic and Standard plans is public.

facts.fact: Stealth Mode, which keeps all generations private, is available only on the Pro and Mega Midjourney plans.
facts.quote: Stealth Mode, which is only available on the Pro and Mega plans, makes all your generations completely private.

facts.fact: The Midjourney Standard plan costs $30 per month.
facts.quote: At **$30 per month**, you get **15 Fast GPU hours**

facts.fact: The Midjourney Standard plan includes 15 Fast GPU hours per month.
facts.quote: At **$30 per month**, you get **15 Fast GPU hours** and, more importantly, unlimited Relax Mode generations.

facts.fact: The Midjourney Standard plan includes unlimited Relax Mode generations.
facts.quote: you get **15 Fast GPU hours** and, more importantly, unlimited Relax Mode generations.

facts.fact: The Standard plan offers full commercial rights for businesses earning under $1M in revenue, according to the page.

facts.fact: Monthly Fast GPU hours do not roll over to the next billing month.
facts.quote: No, your monthly **Fast GPU hours** don't carry over to the next month.

facts.fact: Paid members can buy extra Fast GPU hours at $4 per hour.
facts.quote: any paid member can buy extra Fast GPU hours for **$4 per hour**.

facts.fact: Midjourney stopped offering a free trial in early 2024.
facts.quote: No, Midjourney stopped offering a free trial back in early **2024**.

facts.fact: The Midjourney Basic plan costs $10 per month and is the lowest-priced paid plan.
facts.quote: which start with the **$10/month Basic plan**.
